(() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-part=stick-upper] circle[data-edu-hit]').getBoundingClientRect(); window.__b = b; const el = document.querySelector('[data-part=stick-upper]'); const st = document.querySelector('.iso-stage'); const x = b.left + b.width/2, y = b.top + b.height/2; el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { bubbles: true, clientX: x, clientY: y, pointerId: 7, button: 0 })); st.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { bubbles: true, clientX: x + 40, clientY: y, pointerId: 7, buttons: 1 })); return 'ball ' + Math.round(x) + ',' + Math.round(y); })()

(() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-part=stick-upper] circle[data-edu-hit]').getBoundingClientRect(); return 'ball now ' + Math.round(b.left + b.width/2) + ',' + Math.round(b.top + b.height/2) + ' closed=' + [...document.querySelectorAll('.ac-switch[data-on]')].length + ' seg=' + [...document.querySelectorAll('.edu-seg[aria-checked=true]')].map(b=>b.textContent).join(','); })()

(() => { const b = window.__b; const st = document.querySelector('.iso-stage'); const x = b.left + b.width/2, y = b.top + b.height/2; st.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { bubbles: true, clientX: x, clientY: y - 40, pointerId: 7, buttons: 1 })); return 1; })()
